text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Oka Sho—an incredibly significant Classic race that Umamusume can enter only once in their careers. The audience is going wild!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion catches a glimpse of a certain Umamusume trembling with nerves. Seeing how seriously she's taking the race leaves Fine Motion in awe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's winner will be whomever shines brightest. Met with a firm reminder of the race's importance, Fine Motion finds new resolve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Being a foreign dignitary, Fine Motion attracts excessive levels of attention, but an elegant smile settles the commotion. She looks calm as she gets ready for the race.
